title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00095 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:45: Continued building scaffolding in moonpool meanwhile prepared equipment for BOP test
00:45 - 01:00: Performed TBT for removing motor from BOP crane to allow skidding BOP and for testing BOP.
01:00 - 02:00: Removed motor from BOP crane.
02:00 - 03:00: Tested MPR with 3 1/2" mandrel to 20/345 bar for 5/10min.
03:00 - 05:45: Tested kelly hose, upper and lower ibops to 20/345 bar for 5/10min. Meanwhile prepared for skidding BOP over well center.
05:45 - 07:00: Skidded BOP over well center and soft landed same.
07:00 - 07:15: Performed TBT for m/u nt2 connector
07:15 - 10:30: Landed BOP on riser and confirmed nt2 connector landed correctly on riser. M/u nt2 connector between BOP and riser. Meanwhile performed TBT for testing kill manifold.
10:30 - 14:15: Installed tension cylinders on BOP. Meanwhile prepared slick joint for running. Tested kill manifold to 20/345bar for 5/10min.
14:15 - 15:30: Installed slick joint
15:30 - 16:00: Secured rotary by installing master bushings and outer ring. R/u chain sling to diverter and moved same to well center
16:00 - 16:30: Removed master bushings and outer ring to run diverter. Ran diverter. Meanwhile tested standpipe manifold to 20/345 bar for 5/10min.
16:30 - 17:15: Aligned BOP to diverter with tension cylinders and BOP carrier. Landed diverter.
17:15 - 17:45: Removed diverter lifting arrangement. Meanwhile m/u slick joint
17:45 - 18:30: R/d chain slings from TDS and installed elevator. Pressure tested diverter to 103bar and overshot packer to 20 bar.
18:30 - 19:00: Filled riser with SW using rig pumps
19:00 - 19:30: Performed TBT prior to work on fingerboard
19:30 - 19:45: Performed TBT for connector test
19:45 - 20:30: Performed connector test to 20/280 bar for 5/10 min
20:30 - 21:30: Adjusted fingerboad for 7in
21:30 - 21:45: Performed TBT for rigging up handling equipment
21:45 - 00:00: R/u handling equipment for pulling tubing
